members.name: root
members.doc: Document, plot container or application subtree. Defaults to document.

members.name: timeout
members.doc: Total readiness/settling budget in milliseconds; defaults to 30000.

members.name: work
members.doc: What the plot did to get here (2026-10-22): mark preparations and transform runs by cause.

ScreenMapping.doc: A completed 2D Cartesian draw's immutable mapping. Positions are canvas-local CSS pixels.

members.name: project
members.type: (point: { x: number; y: number; }) => { x: number; y: number; inside: boolean; } | null

members.name: unproject
members.type: (point: { x: number; y: number; }) => { x: number; y: number; } | null

LightSpec.doc: A scene light for lit marks. Positions use world coordinates.

members.name: kind
members.doc: Ambient reaches every surface; directional aims toward the origin; hemisphere blends sky and ground; point shines from a position.

members.name: color
members.doc: A CSS color, default white.

members.name: intensity
members.doc: Light strength, at least zero; default 1.

members.name: position
members.doc: World position for directional and point lights; the up direction for hemisphere. Default [0, 1, 0], or [0, 0, 0] for point.

members.name: groundColor
members.doc: Hemisphere light's ground color, default white.

members.name: distance
members.doc: Point light's maximum reach in world units; default 0 means unlimited.

members.name: decay
members.doc: Point light's distance falloff exponent: default 2 is inverse square, 0 is constant.

members.name: domain
members.type: [number, number] | [Date, Date] | [number | Expression | Date, number | Expression | Date] | "auto"
members.doc: The data range the axis spans; "auto" (the default) spans the marks' data, widened by padding and, on a 2D linear numeric axis, rounded out to tick values. Two dates make a datetime axis over them. Ends that are reductions (extent(column, {where})) are read from the data and follow it and the selection; automatic while no row matches.

members.name: transform
members.doc: How data maps to the axis: "linear" (default), "log", "sqrt" or "symlog"; under log a value at or below zero is missing.

members.name: range
members.doc: Where the domain lands in the parent frame's coordinates (a Frame's sub-range of its parent axis).

members.name: constant
members.doc: symlog's constant c > 0 (default 1): the axis is linear within ±c and logarithmic beyond.

members.name: invert
members.doc: Flip the axis direction on screen (top-to-bottom for y, right-to-left for x, near-to-far for z).

members.name: scale
members.doc: A categorical scale: the axis becomes one band per category, in the scale's order.

members.name: label
members.doc: The axis title. Empty (or null) means automatic: the axis is titled by a categorical position scale's label, else by the name of the one column its marks plot there (through a Facet's value/x/y aliases and transform outputs such as a Bin's edges); an axis whose marks plot several columns, only constants, raw arrays or expressions, or nothing has no title. A Frame that sets its own domain, range, transform or scale for this dimension reads only its own label.

members.name: visible
members.doc: false hides the axis (its line, ticks and labels).

members.name: side
members.doc: Which side the axis is drawn on; "right" or "top" for a second axis.

members.name: type
members.doc: "datetime" labels positions as times counted from origin in timezone; a Date or datetime64 column sets it.

members.name: origin
members.doc: Datetime axes: the time (a Date, or Unix milliseconds) positions count from.

members.name: timezone
members.doc: Datetime axes: the IANA time zone labels and calendar intervals use (default UTC).

members.name: format
members.doc: A d3-format string (".1f", ",") or, on a datetime axis, a time pattern ("%b %d").

members.name: majorInterval
members.doc: Datetime axes: the calendar step between major ticks ("1 month", "15 minutes").

members.name: minorInterval
members.doc: Datetime axes: the calendar step between minor ticks.

members.name: major
members.doc: false hides the major ticks and their labels.

members.name: minor
members.doc: Draw minor ticks between the major ones (subdivisions of each step).

members.name: step
members.doc: The spacing between major ticks, in data units, instead of an automatic choice.

members.name: tickCount
members.doc: About how many major ticks to draw; the axis picks round values near that count. Automatic: about one per 80 px along a 2D linear numeric x axis and per 45 px along y, else per 90 px.

members.name: subdivisions
members.doc: How many minor intervals each major step splits into (at least 2; default 5).

members.name: minorStep
members.doc: The spacing between minor ticks, in data units, instead of subdivisions.

members.name: padding
members.doc: An automatic domain's margin on each side, as a fraction of its span (default 0.04); on a 2D linear numeric axis the padded ends then round out to tick values, and 0 keeps the data's ends. An explicit domain is not padded.

members.name: grid
members.doc: Grid lines at the major ticks ("major") or at major and minor ticks ("major-minor"); "off" draws none.

members.name: line
members.doc: Show the baseline independently of ticks, labels, grids and arrows.

members.name: ticks
members.doc: Show tick marks independently of tick labels.

members.name: tickSize
members.doc: Tick length in CSS pixels; defaults to the theme's tick size.

members.name: tickDirection
members.doc: Tick direction relative to the axes interior.

members.name: titleFontWeight
members.doc: Numeric title font weight from 1 to 1000.

members.name: gridColor
members.doc: Grid stroke color; omitted adapts to the background.

members.name: gridWidth
members.doc: Grid stroke width in CSS pixels.

members.name: gridDash
members.doc: Alternating dash and gap lengths in CSS pixels; [] draws solid grids.

members.name: lineWidth
members.doc: The baseline's stroke width in CSS pixels; 0 hides the baseline and arrow shafts.

members.name: tickWidth
members.doc: The tick marks' stroke width in CSS pixels.

members.name: arrow
members.doc: An arrowhead at the axis's start, end or both ends.

members.name: arrowSize
members.doc: The arrowhead's size in CSS pixels.

members.name: labelOverlap
members.doc: "hide" (default) drops tick labels that would overlap their neighbors; "show" keeps them all.

members.name: tickLabelAngle
members.doc: Rotates the tick labels, in degrees.

members.name: tickLabelAlign
members.doc: How tick labels align to their ticks; "auto" chooses by the axis side and angle.

members.name: tickLabelPlacement
members.doc: Tick labels outside the axes interior (default) or inside it.

members.name: tickLabelOffset
members.doc: Extra distance between tick labels and the axis, in CSS pixels.

members.name: titlePosition
members.doc: Where the title sits along the axis: at its start, middle or end.

members.name: titleAngle
members.doc: The title's rotation in degrees; "auto" reads along a vertical axis.

members.name: titlePlacement
members.doc: The title outside the axes interior (default) or inside it.

members.name: titleOffset
members.doc: Extra distance between the title and the tick labels, in CSS pixels.

members.name: context
members.doc: Datetime x axes: a second row of labels where the coarser unit changes (the date under hours, the month and year under days); default true.

members.name: breaks
members.doc: Datetime axes: intervals the axis leaves out, in its time zone ("weekends", { hours: [16, 9.5] } every day, { dates: ["2026-12-25"] } whole days, { from, to } one interval).

members.name: calendar
members.doc: A model calendar's axis (set from its column): "360_day", "all_leap" or "noleap", with the column's units ("days since 1850-01-01").

members.name: axis
members.doc: "x" draws a vertical rule at an x value, "y" a horizontal one.

members.name: value
members.doc: Where the rule is, in the axis's units: a number, a Date or an ISO date.

members.name: label
members.doc: Text at the rule's end.

members.name: color
members.doc: The rule's color; default the axis text color.

members.name: width
members.doc: The rule's stroke width in CSS pixels.

members.name: dash
members.doc: Alternating dash and gap lengths in CSS pixels; [] or omitted draws a solid rule.

ReferenceBand.doc: A shaded span of an axis, drawn behind the marks and grid lines.

members.name: axis
members.doc: "x" shades a vertical strip (in a polar frame, a wedge of angles), "y" a horizontal one (a ring of radii).

members.name: from
members.doc: One end, in the axis's units: a number, a Date, or an ISO date ("2024-03-01" or "2024-03-01T09:30" in the axis's time zone, or with an offset such as "2024-03-01T12:00:00Z").

members.name: to
members.doc: The other end (either order).

members.name: label
members.doc: Text at the band's start, like a rule's label.

members.name: color
members.doc: A six-digit hex color. Default the axis text color.

members.name: opacity
members.doc: 0 to 1. Default 0.1.

members.name: fields
members.doc: The fields to list (default: the columns the mark's channels read).

members.name: radius
members.doc: How near the pointer a row is found, in CSS pixels (default 16).

members.name: content
members.type: Snippet<[{ values: Record<string, unknown>; row: number; mark: string; lines: { label: string; text: string; }[]; }]>
members.doc: Svelte only: the box's content, given { values, row, mark, lines }.

FramePlacement.doc: A coordinate frame. Nested ranges are expressed in parent data coordinates.

members.name: version
members.doc: Descriptor version. Omitted means a legacy (version 1) descriptor; any other value is rejected.

members.name: orientation
members.doc: Defaults to tangent on spherical parents, parent otherwise.

members.name: name
members.doc: The theme's name, shown in the settings pane. A name that starts with a partial theme's group ("axes/", "legend/", "title/", "controls/", "numbers/", "animation/", "marks/") makes the theme a partial: it should set only that section, and warns when it sets others.

members.name: extends
members.doc: Inherit from themes: a preset name (matched ignoring case and punctuation), a partial theme's name ("axes/minimal", "legend/inline-top", "title/centered", "numbers/currency", ...), a theme definition, a theme resource, or a list of them merged left to right, as in ["paper", "axes/minimal", "legend/inline-top"]. This definition's keys merge over the result: objects merge key by key, lists (a palette) replace.

members.name: vectorTile
members.doc: VectorTile's color scheme under this theme: part -> style (or false), as VectorTile's styles.

members.name: view
members.doc: The plot area: background is its color.

members.name: typography
members.type: { fontFamily?: string | undefined; fontSize?: number | undefined; color?: string | undefined; }
members.doc: Text everywhere unless a part overrides it: font family, size in CSS pixels and color.

members.name: axes
members.type: { fontFamily?: string | undefined; fontSize?: number | undefined; color?: string | undefined; textColor?: string | undefined; line?: boolean | undefined; ticks?: boolean | undefined; tickDirection?: "outside" | "inside" | "both" | undefined; titleFontWeight?: number | undefined; gridColor?: string | undefined; gridWidth?: number | undefined; gridDash?: number[] | undefined; frame?: boolean | undefined; mask?: boolean | undefined; threeD?: Axes3DConfig | undefined; lineWidth?: number | undefined; tickSize?: number | undefined; grid?: "off" | "major" | "major-minor" | undefined; marginLeft?: number | "auto" | undefined; marginRight?: number | "auto" | undefined; marginTop?: number | "auto" | undefined; marginBottom?: number | "auto" | undefined; arrow?: "both" | "none" | "start" | "end" | undefined; arrowSize?: number | undefined; titlePosition?: "start" | "end" | "middle" | undefined; titleAngle?: number | "auto" | undefined; titlePlacement?: "outside" | "inside" | undefined; titleOffset?: number | undefined; tickLabelAngle?: number | undefined; tickLabelAlign?: "auto" | "start" | "end" | "middle" | undefined; tickLabelPlacement?: "outside" | "inside" | undefined; tickLabelOffset?: number | undefined; }
members.doc: Axis lines, ticks, labels, titles, grids and margins (see AxisDefinition for each key).

members.name: guides
members.type: { fontFamily?: string | undefined; fontSize?: number | undefined; textColor?: string | undefined; }
members.doc: Legends and colorbars: their fonts, colors and spacing.

members.name: numbers
members.doc: Numbers: format is a d3-format string (",.2f", "$,.0f", ".1%") that linear axis ticks, legends and tooltips use where they set no format of their own; dates keep theirs.

members.name: controls
members.type: { accentColor?: string | undefined; fontSize?: number | undefined; }
members.doc: Inputs (Slider, Select, Button, Checkbox, Playback, ...): accentColor colors a slider's handle and fill, a checked box and the focus ring (default palette[0]); fontSize is their text size in CSS pixels (default typography.fontSize). A page's --hm-controls-* variables win.

members.name: animation
members.type: { duration?: number | undefined; easing?: "linear" | "quad-in" | "quad-out" | "quad-in-out" | "cubic-in" | "cubic-out" | "cubic-in-out" | "sine-in-out" | undefined; enter?: boolean | "fade" | { effect?: "fade" | undefined; duration?: number | undefined; easing?: "linear" | "quad-in" | "quad-out" | "quad-in-out" | "cubic-in" | "cubic-out" | "cubic-in-out" | "sine-in-out" | undefined; } | undefined; exit?: boolean | "fade" | { effect?: "fade" | undefined; duration?: number | undefined; easing?: "linear" | "quad-in" | "quad-out" | "quad-in-out" | "cubic-in" | "cubic-out" | "cubic-in-out" | "sine-in-out" | undefined; } | undefined; }
members.doc: Animated changes: duration (milliseconds) and easing are a Plot's animationDuration and animationEasing, enter and exit a mark's enterEffect and exitEffect, where those are not set. It does not turn animation on: a Plot's or mark's `animation` does.

members.name: marks
members.type: Record<string, Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>>
members.doc: Mark defaults. A null ordinary mark color/fill clears an inherited color and uses palette[0].

members.name: palette
members.doc: The categorical colors, in order, for marks colored by a category.

members.name: colormap
members.doc: Default colormap for continuous fills and colors without an explicit colormap.

members.name: missing
members.doc: The color of a missing value (NaN or null) in a colormapped fill or color, unless its scale sets `missing` (default "#92989f", a neutral gray).

members.name: shapes
members.doc: Custom point shapes registered when the theme applies: name -> vertices in [-1, 1] or an M/L/Z path.

members.name: width
members.doc: The page width: CSS pixels, or a CSS length ("20cm").

members.name: height
members.doc: The page height: CSS pixels, or a CSS length.

members.name: mode
members.doc: "auto" (default) draws what has no vector form as images, "vector" refuses it, "raster" draws the whole plot as one image.

members.name: rasterDpi
members.doc: The images' resolution (default 300).

members.name: text
members.doc: "embedded" keeps text selectable with its fonts embedded; "outlines" draws it as paths, so it looks the same without the fonts.

members.name: primitiveBudget
members.doc: The most vector pieces one export draws (default 100,000): a mark past it is drawn as an image, or refused in "vector" mode.

members.name: getDescription
members.doc: The plot's description as screen readers get it (description=, then the generated summary), updated when the plot settles after a change.

members.name: getTitle
members.doc: The plot's title as shown ("" without one).

members.name: subscribeDescription
members.doc: Called with the description whenever it changes, and once at once; returns a function that stops it.

members.name: getOffsets
members.doc: The table's offsets (dragging).

members.name: resetOffsets
members.doc: Clear the table's offsets in `columns` (every column when omitted).

members.name: applyOffsets
members.doc: The table as given, with each column that has offsets replaced by its moved values.

members.name: whenSettled
members.doc: Resolves once the changes made before the call are drawn; later changes are not waited for.

members.name: exportVideo
members.type: (options: { duration: number; fps?: number | undefined; start?: number | undefined; scale?: number | undefined; }) => Promise<Blob>
members.doc: The animation as an MP4 (H.264, else VP9) encoded in the browser with WebCodecs: one PNG export per frame at a frozen clock time from `start` for `duration` ms; the clock is restored afterwards. Loads hmplot/video on first use.

members.name: setViewport
members.doc: Resolves once the viewport is applied, like setCamera.

members.name: getCamera
members.doc: The 3D camera state, or undefined for a 2D plot.

members.name: setCamera
members.type: (camera: Partial<Omit<CameraState, "mode">>, options?: { animate?: boolean | undefined; } | undefined) => Promise<void>
members.doc: Merge a partial 3D camera state; {animate: true} eases over the plot's animationDuration.

members.name: getAnimationTime
members.doc: The clock in milliseconds, shared by the Plots of its scope (an InputContext, a Scene, a standalone Facet or a Simulate; else the Plot's own): 0 when the scope starts, advanced by the frame time while anything in it animates, still while frozen. `@time` and every transition read it.

members.name: getAnimationTimeFrozen
members.doc: Whether setAnimationTime froze the clock.

members.name: setAnimationTime
members.type: (time: number | null, options?: { freeze?: boolean | undefined; } | undefined) => Promise<void>
members.doc: Set the clock of the Plot's scope. With freeze (default) it stops there until setAnimationTime(null) resumes it, so exports capture that moment: transitions and

members.name: fit
members.doc: Reset the view: 2D returns to the full domain; 3D recomputes the camera position.

members.name: getScreenMapping
members.doc: The last completed draw's mapping; null before drawing, after disposal or for unsupported coordinates.

members.name: subscribeScreenMapping
members.doc: Receives the current mapping immediately and changes after completed draws. Returns an unsubscribe function.

members.name: action
members.doc: Runs one of the transform's named actions (such as a layout's reheat); resolves when its work settles.

members.name: read
members.type: { (options?: (ReadOptions & { rows?: false | undefined; }) | undefined): Promise<HostColumns>; (options: ReadOptions & { rows: true; }): Promise<HostRows>; }
members.doc: Its output's rows on the host, once its current inputs have run: for a value code shows in the page (a total in a sentence, a breadcrumb, a list). One read per call, bounded by limit.readback; subscribe() says when the output changes, so a readout is subscribe then read. Marks draw the output without it.

members.name: normalization
members.doc: A shared normalization resource: scales that take the same one share its domain, transform and midpoint (configure those on it, not here).

members.name: domain
members.doc: Two numbers, or "symmetric": the data's extent centered on zero.

members.name: transform
members.doc: How values map to the range: "linear" (default), "log", "sqrt" or "symlog".

members.name: constant
members.doc: symlog's constant c > 0 (default 1): the transform is linear within ±c.

members.name: midpoint
members.doc: A diverging scale's center (d3's scaleDiverging): the domain's halves map to the range's halves, [lo, midpoint] to [0, 0.5] and [midpoint, hi] to [0.5, 1], each linearly in transformed space, so a diverging colormap's middle color falls on the midpoint and both of its ends are used. An explicit domain must contain it; an automatic one grows to. Value scales only (color, size, width), not position axes.

members.name: domainSource
members.doc: Where an automatic domain comes from: "data" (default), the rows the mark draws, or "source", the table before Filters, so colors stay put while a filter changes.

members.name: range
members.doc: The output range of a size or width scale, in CSS pixels.

members.name: colormap
members.doc: The colors of a color scale: a colormap name ("Viridis") or a list of colors.

members.name: quantize
members.doc: Step the values into `levels` colors instead of a smooth gradient.

members.name: levels
members.doc: How many colors quantize steps through.

members.name: missing
members.doc: The color a missing value (NaN or null) of a colormapped fill or color draws in, on screen, in exports and in its legend (default: the theme's `missing`, a neutral gray). A color scale only: a scale with a numeric range has no colors.

members.name: label
members.doc: Title of the legend guide shared by the marks using this scale.

members.name: by
members.doc: The column the selection matches rows by (selection({by: "gene"})): every row with a value the selected rows have is a member, in any table with that column; null for row identity.

members.name: status
members.type: () => { active: boolean; previewActive: boolean; count: number; revision: number; previewRevision: number; membership: number; }
members.doc: `membership` counts changes of the selected rows; committing a preview (the same rows) bumps `revision` but not `membership`.

members.name: subscribe
members.type: (listener: (status: { active: boolean; previewActive: boolean; count: number; revision: number; previewRevision: number; membership: number; }) => void) => () => void

members.name: clearColumns
members.type: (owner: string | string[] | DataIdentity, columns?: string | string[] | { identity: string; }[] | undefined) => SelectionResource

members.name: replace
members.type: (owner: DataIdentity | Iterable<number>, rows?: Iterable<number> | undefined, options?: { phase?: "committed" | "preview" | undefined; activate?: boolean | undefined; } | undefined) => SelectionResource

members.name: add
members.type: (owner: DataIdentity | Iterable<number>, rows?: Iterable<number> | undefined) => SelectionResource

members.name: remove
members.type: (owner: DataIdentity | Iterable<number>, rows?: Iterable<number> | undefined) => SelectionResource

members.name: toggle
members.type: (owner: DataIdentity | Iterable<number>, rows?: Iterable<number> | undefined) => SelectionResource

ConnectOptions.doc: connect() options. key matches rows by one column's exact values ("1" never matches 1); without it, endpoints must show observations of one table. order: "facet" (the default, and the only order) applies to one endpoint passed alone, which must be a mark repeated in Facet cells or Partition groups: it connects the cells in facet order.

members.name: key
members.doc: A column matched by exact value in every endpoint; without it, the endpoints must show observations of one table, matched by identity.

members.name: order
members.doc: "facet" (the default and only order): one endpoint repeated in Facet cells or Partition groups connects its cells in facet order.

members.name: zoomX
members.doc: The horizontal zoom factor, when x and y zoom apart (1 fits the domain).

members.name: zoomY
members.doc: The vertical zoom factor, when x and y zoom apart.

members.name: center
members.doc: Active root longitude and latitude in its angular units.

ReductionOptions.doc: Optional participation predicate; intersects visible rows rather than changing membership.

members.name: by
members.doc: Columns that group the rows: each row gets its own group's value (as pandas' transform).

members.name: where
members.doc: A condition (a boolean column or expression): only the rows where it is true are reduced.

members.name: by
members.doc: Columns that group the rows: each row gets its own group's value (as pandas' transform).

members.name: orderBy
members.doc: Columns that order the rows within each group for the calculation; results return to the rows' own places.

members.name: order
members.doc: Ascending (default) or descending orderBy.

OrderedExpressionOptions.doc: Local calculation order; results return to the source rows. Sort reorders whole tables.

members.doc: Columns that group the rows: each group is calculated on its own.

members.name: orderBy
members.doc: Columns that order the rows within each group for the calculation; results return to the rows' own places.

members.name: order
members.doc: Ascending (default) or descending orderBy.

members.name: periods
members.doc: Nonnegative row offset; zero is identity.

members.name: fill
members.doc: Missing by default; int32 buffers require an explicit integer fill for exact values.

members.name: by
members.doc: Columns that group the rows: each group is calculated on its own.

members.name: size

members.name: reduce

members.name: align
members.doc: Where the window sits around each row: "trailing" (the row and those before it, default), "center" or "leading".
